replies.body:
Dude, I find this a very good post, which sums up my views, however, not entirely. I think that the "I'm leaving for a week" posts are ANNOYING and attention seeking, but when you've been on the server for over a year or so, been involved with the community a hell of a lot and want to say a few goodbyes, that's not a huge problem. it's nice to see a few goodbye messages accumulated in one place, for you to see when you leave, as a reminder of what an awesome community you've been part of... 
All in all, they shouldn't be in the Recent Topics, as, they're not that handy, and anyway, of someone was leaving, they would've told their friends via Skype etc, anyway. 
I have sorta contradicted my self, but not, I have mixed feelings about this, but I basically think they're a bad idea, but do not fully support a full on ban.

replies.author: Phobiaxx
replies.body:
Solution:
Leaving threads are allowed.

Compromise:
1.If found "fake" forum temp-ban depending on circumstances+archive thread.
2.If player realizes avicus is just too fun, leave them be, and archive the thread.
3.have a specific sector just for leaving threads, 'non-updating', so Recent Discussions is left clean.
4.ask leaving players to leave a link to the thread in their profile.(It's better for it to be in a thread, so people can be convinced to come back, we don't want to lose so much good players D:)
